title: In Your Hands trailer + how we used AI for our art pipeline and some of the BGM (Suno)
author: DepartmentPlus5191
selftext:
Hey everyone! We're Nibble & Hop, and we just finished the trailer for In Your Hands, a point-and-click psychological horror sound novel coming to Steam. Since this sub is all about building games with AI, I wanted to share how we actually used it in our workflow.

**Art**

Before generating any images, we used AI to build a style prompt first, basically locking down the visual direction in words. Once we got a rough draft image we were happy with, we fed it back in as a reference, which helped us keep the overall art structure consistent across assets. AI gave us the foundation, but all the fine details were fixed and polished by hand in Photoshop. Honestly, that cleanup stage took more time than we expected, especially \[e.g. keeping characters consistent / fixing small details\].

**Music**

Some of the BGM tracks were made with Suno. For a sound novel, the music carries a lot of the atmosphere, so this part mattered a lot to us. We used AI to refine our prompts so they matched the way Suno interprets them, then generated from there. One trick that worked well: when a generation had a part we liked, we kept it up to that point and continued generating from there, instead of rerolling the whole track. That made it much easier to get the tension and mood we wanted.

Happy to answer any questions about the workflow. I'm also curious how others here handle style consistency between generations. What's worked for you?

  
Steam : [Link](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5193580/)

comments.author: ASAF12341
comments.body: The story sounds good; in this genre of visual novel, I think the images need to be better than what I see, but maybe it is just me, as I want them to be more unique and eye-catching.

replies.author: DepartmentPlus5191
replies.body: Thanks for the great suggestion! While we might be able to upgrade the artwork later, we focused on finding an art style that fits the game's story and atmosphere as we currently envision them.
